title: Google Trekker recording the Heaphy Track, published 2015
altText: Google Trekker operator carrying the backpack panorama camera along the Heaphy Track beside a track sign.
caption: Google Trekker field capture on the Heaphy Track, photographed by DOC GIS analyst Peter Hiemstra and published in November 2015. DOC’s account describes battery planning and carrying the equipment along the 78.4 km track.
dateDisplay: Published 6 November 2015; exact capture date unstated
context: DOC’s own account documents the named Street View field programme, the people and tracks. Its footer links to DOC’s Crown-copyright CC BY 4.0 policy. No separate third-party copyright notice appears on these photographs.
derivativesNote: Unchanged source JPEG retained; uncropped WebP display and thumbnail copies. No reconstructed historical content.
